LanguageData.VRE_Aggression_ExtremelyAggressive.descr: Carriers of this gene are incredibly aggressive and are offended by almost anything. They will always respond to insults and slights with a social fight, and will not hesitate to use their melee weapons to get their point across. Mental breaks are always violent.
LanguageData.VRE_Aggression_ExtremelyAggressive.label: extremely aggressive
